info.title: New business applications by county (Census Business Formation Statistics): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
New business applications by county (Census Business Formation Statistics): Business applications (requests for a new Employer Identification Number) in every U.S. county from 2005 to 2025, with each county's latest count, the change over a year and since 2019, and the sums for each state and the nation, from the Census Bureau's Business Formation Statistics annual county file. The Census Bureau applied differentially private noise to the June 2026 release, so every record is flagged noise; county sums are checked against the Bureau's own monthly state series.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
